text:
## Summary

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc (policy CC-1592): power surge after a storm damaged a laptop and a phone at a conference venue in Bristol. The loss falls within clause 4.9, but cover depends on the equipment having been connected through a surge protector, and the file does not say whether it was. The decision is therefore pending that confirmation. The reserve is 6,598 dollars.

## Facts

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc reported the loss on 11 March 2026 under policy CC-1592 [notice of loss]. The loss was a power surge after a storm, affecting a laptop and a phone [notice of loss]. It occurred at a conference venue in Bristol [notice of loss]. An incident report, reference IR/2026/4208, was made on 13 March 2026 by the insured [incident report]. It records a power surge after a storm at a conference venue in Bristol, with no third party involved [incident report]. The laptop is invoiced at 3,892 dollars by Beacon Office Supply [invoice 1]. The phone is invoiced at 2,706 dollars by Crane & Sons Electronics [invoice 2]. The file does not state whether the equipment was connected through a surge protector [notice of loss], [incident report]. The file contains no policy schedule.

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.9 of the policy, which covers damage to electronic equipment caused by a surge in the electrical supply, where the equipment was connected through a surge protector [policy]. A laptop and a phone are electronic equipment, and the loss is described as a power surge [notice of loss], [incident report]. The surge protector condition is not evidenced in the file, so clause 4.9 cannot yet be confirmed as satisfied.

Clause 4.2 is not relied on. It covers storm damage at the scheduled premises or at other premises while the items are in the insured's custody [policy], and the file does not state where the items were held or by whom [notice of loss], [incident report].

Exclusions:
- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it concerns theft of unattended portable equipment, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: it concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is described as a single event, a surge after a storm [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it concerns losses where theft is alleged, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.9, subject to one condition: written confirmation from the insured that the laptop and phone were connected through a surge protector at the time of the surge. No exclusion applies. Until that confirmation is on file, the claim should not be accepted or declined.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,598 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (3,892 dollars and 2,706 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the file, because no schedule is included, and clause 9.1 provides that where no excess is shown in the schedule none applies [policy]. The schedule should be checked before the reserve is finalised.
